rules.requiredBeforeWriter: Deny all direct SDK writes, including legacy pilots, while preserving active calendar readers
rules.fallback: Keep client-write denial and disable server/UI writers; never roll back by reopening SDK writes

requestSequence.expected: Both HTTP 200; exactly one created=1 and one repeated=true, created=0
HTTP 400; one otherwise valid classroom plus a different-title overlap with the committed manual; neither is saved
HTTP 200; reviewed PDF output creates two classrooms atomically
HTTP 200; reviewed image output creates two evening rounds using bound directory IDs
HTTP 400; a different-title overlap with the first DL round; combined room/proctor overlap, not isolated proctor-only evidence
HTTP 409; new mutation input with original version=0 after edit; not a frozen receipt replay
HTTP 200; isActive=false, mutationVersion=2; preserve the document
Four HTTP 200 replies, repeated=true with created/changed=0; no new receipts or gate increments

preconditions: Review and explicitly approve the fresh staging baseline read before binding IDs or freezing cloud operations
Freeze actual directory IDs, source SHA, Rules hashes, all payloads, deterministic targets and operation IDs; obtain cloud action approval
Stop old pilot tabs and in-flight writes; record baseline gate revision and synthetic ownership
Verify complete adapter output and active bounded collections <=200; stop on partial or oversized baseline
Pace at most 10 POSTs per UID in any rolling 60 seconds, below runtime limit 12; concurrent and rejected requests consume budget too
Check proposed dates and rooms against fresh staging schedules; never silently move dates or remove conflicts
Approve and deploy exact deny-client-write Rules before enabling trusted writer; verify reader queries and direct-write denial
Keep connectivity=0; enable server/UI writer only during the explicitly approved QA window
No paid service, billing enablement, new key, IAM change, profile change or production access
evidenceRequirements: Record request reservation before each POST, response status/count/operationId and bounded ownership audit after each stage
A read-only trusted audit channel must be reviewed before execution; the new Rules deny SDK receipt/gate reads, so legacy replay tooling is insufficient
Freeze edit original and post-edit cancellation original once; replay exactly those payloads
Observe unchanged gate and document counts for rejection/replay; distinguish UI read-back failure from successful commit
Verify browser manual/PDF/image review on desktop/mobile; imported data must match the frozen fixture
If any rejected request writes, stop immediately, disable writer and preserve unexpected records for review; do not delete to repair evidence
deferredCoverage: Cloud Staff/no-capability/inactive/revoked-token HTTP denial requires a separate bounded authorization matrix; existing Emulator coverage does not prove cloud coverage
Distinct conflicting concurrent writers and isolated proctor-only conflict remain Emulator evidence unless separately budgeted
Lost HTTP response/read-back failure remain controlled Emulator/transport evidence unless an explicit non-destructive browser fault method is reviewed

stopAndRollback.onUnexpectedStatusIdentityHashOrCount: Stop further POSTs, disable server/UI writer and retain frozen payloads/receipts for review
stopAndRollback.afterQa: Deploy server write=0/connectivity=0, verify HTTPS health, keep direct client writes denied, preserve all committed documents and receipts
stopAndRollback.uncertainCommit: Do not invent a new operation or assert cancellation; consume only a reserved replay request with the identical frozen payload after reviewer-directed receipt audit
stopAndRollback.rulesDeploymentFailure: Do not enable writer; keep the last reviewed write-off service and report which Rules actually remain deployed
